proposed_classifications.INCOMPLETE: Required context, linkage or coverage is missing.
proposed_classifications.UNDER REVIEW: Designated reviewer is examining a supplied record.
proposed_classifications.EVIDENCE SUPPORTS SPECIFIED USE: Reviewer records support tied to exact asset, use and applicable restrictions.
proposed_classifications.EVIDENCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH SPECIFIED US: Record fails to establish the reviewed use or remains silent on it.
proposed_classifications.CONFLICTING EVIDENCE: Material sources disagree and require reconciliation.
proposed_classifications.NEEDS QUALIFIED REVIEW: An authorized qualified reviewer must assess unresolved rights or applicability questions.

criteria: Authenticity, applicable source, effective date and context
Distribution and embedding, distinguishing raster and font-file use
Need for qualified review and recorded scope of disposition
stop_conditions: Missing or ambiguous authorization, document or location
Unapproved copy, transfer, contact, external research or scope expansion needed
Mismatch, incomplete evidence or conflict blocks the proposed finding
Legal clearance or production adoption requested outside review authority

preferred_if_available: ER-P0-01 background and backpack linked acquisition and permission records
conditional_alternatives: ER-P0-06 dated applicable service terms matched to a relevant output
ER-P0-02 one exact material reference and applicable permission record

disposition_boundary: Any finding is limited to the specified use and supplied evidence. Legal clearance and production approval require distinct authority.
